afterWrite.name: banned-dash-check
afterWrite.description: Reject em dash, en dash, and double hyphen in any written file
afterWrite.command: grep -nE '—|–|--' $FILE && echo 'BANNED DASH FOUND. Use a period or a comma.' && exit 1 || exit 0

beforeCommit.name: no-dates-in-copy
beforeCommit.description: Submission materials must not carry dates
beforeCommit.command: echo 'Reminder: no dates on README, slides, video descriptions, or write ups.'
